newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks ease in thin London trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks ease in thin London trade.

text.p: Hong Kong shares eased slightly in thin, uneventful trading on Tuesday, traders said.

By 1535 GMT the Hang Seng London Reference index was down 33.54 points at 13,386.62. Earlier in Hong Kong, worries about interest rates erased earlier gains and pushed the Hang Seng index down 23.77 points to close at 13,420.16. Traders said the market was quiet and that all eyes were on Friday's U.S. employment and the U.S. long bond. "There's nothing really in the market. It's a bit tired," said one trader at a major house dealing in Hong Kong stocks in London.
Among the few shares to provide interest was HSBC Holdings, which was quoted at HK$167.82-1/2 by 1532 GMT, up from its close of HK$167.00 in Hong Kong.

Cheung Kong shares were unchanged at HK$72.75. They closed up HK$5.00 in Hong Kong after the lifting of a suspension due to the announcement of a corporate reshuffle, but the rise failed to follow through, traders said.
-- John Sutherland, London Newsroom +44 542 7945 (c) Reuters Limited 1997
